# commercetools_integration_layer_config_entry (Resource)

A config entry of the Commerce Integration Layer extension, which its resolvers read as `ctx.config.<key>`, such as an API key for a service the extension calls. A change takes effect on the next request, without pushing the bundle again.

Each entry is its own resource, and writing one leaves every other key alone, including keys set with the commercetools CLI.

Set `secret_value` for a secret: the Commerce Integration Layer stores it encrypted and never returns it. Terraform keeps the configured value in state and cannot detect that it was changed outside of Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "contentful_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Read by the extension as ctx.config.CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID.
resource "commercetools_integration_layer_config_entry" "contentful_space" {
  key   = "CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID"
  value = "my-space-id"
}

resource "commercetools_integration_layer_config_entry" "contentful_token" {
  key          = "CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN"
  secret_value = var.contentful_access_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Name of the entry, as the extension reads it.

### Optional

- `secret_value` (String, Sensitive) The value, stored as a secret that is never returned. Conflicts with `value`.
- `value` (String) The value, readable by anyone who can read the Project's config. Conflicts with `secret_value`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key of the entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A config entry is imported using its key.
#
# A secret value is not returned by the API. After an import the stored value
# is kept until secret_value is applied.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_config_entry.contentful_token CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN
```
